issue.title: Connecting multiple `documents` outputs to `PromptBuilder.documents` is not possible

llm_context.input_title: Connecting multiple `documents` outputs to `PromptBuilder.documents` is not possible
llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: Connecting multiple retriever outputs (such as retriever_1 and retriever_2) to a single PromptBuilder input socket like prompt_builder.documents fails with a PipelineConnectError because PromptBuilder handles input variables dynamically based on its template, often typing them as Any instead of using a variadic annotation like Variadic[List[Document]], preventing the pipeline connection logic from recognizing it as capable of accepting multiple incoming connections.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: In Haystack pipelines, receiving input sockets only accept multiple incoming connections if they are designated as variadic (either lazy or greedy variadic via `Variadic[...]` type annotations). When `PromptBuilder` parses templates or initializes inputs, sockets corresponding to template variables default to `Any` if not explicitly constrained or typed. As a result, `InputSocket.is_lazy_variadic` and `InputSocket.is_greedy` evaluate to False, and pipeline connection checks reject any subsequent connections after the first one.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect PromptBuilder input initialization
step_by_step_plan.description: Inspect how PromptBuilder initializes its input sockets and templates in haystack/components/builders/prompt_builder.py to identify where template variables are typed as Any.

step_by_step_plan.title: Update template variable typing to support Variadic lists
step_by_step_plan.description: Modify the input socket type definition for template variables in PromptBuilder to allow Variadic[List[Document]] or similar variadic annotations when the input is intended to accept multiple connections.

step_by_step_plan.title: Verify socket variadic checks in pipeline connection logic
step_by_step_plan.description: Inspect haystack/core/pipeline/base.py and haystack/core/component/types.py to ensure that InputSocket correctly identifies the updated PromptBuilder sockets as variadic.

step_by_step_plan.title: Write regression test for multiple retriever connections
step_by_step_plan.description: Add a regression test in tests/core/pipeline/test_pipeline.py or a component builder test file connecting multiple retriever outputs to prompt_builder.documents and asserting successful execution and aggregation.

step_by_step_plan.title: Run test suite verification
step_by_step_plan.description: Execute pytest to verify that the pipeline connection succeeds without raising PipelineConnectError and that all tests pass successfully.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Special input sockets in Haystack pipelines that can accept data from multiple upstream sender components simultaneously.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Without variadic sockets, components like builders or joiners would be restricted to receiving input from a single source, limiting flexibility when combining multiple retrievers or data sources.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: The PromptBuilder's `documents` socket needs to be recognized or configured as variadic so that multiple retrievers can feed documents into it without triggering connection errors.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: The mechanism by which Haystack inspects Python type hints (such as `Variadic[T]`) using typing metadata and annotations to configure runtime pipeline behavior.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Pipeline connection validation relies entirely on inspecting component socket type hints during initialization to determine graph connectivity rules.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Because template variables default to `Any`, they lack the metadata required for the pipeline builder to identify them as variadic, leading to strict single-connection enforcement.

common_pitfalls: Modifying pipeline connection checks globally without considering whether standard non-variadic sockets should still enforce single connections.
Forgetting to update PromptBuilder initialization or variable type inference when templates define list-like variables.
